title: The nightly finds flaky and uncollected tests and keeps quarantines honest

tasks.title: Collection check, flake detection and quarantine
nightly.yml, disabled e2e-reader.yml and the Stryker config

acs.text: WHEN the suites have run three times THE SYSTEM SHALL list every test whose result differs between runs and fail when one is not quarantined
scenarios: AC-001 list every test whose result differs between runs and fail when one is not quarantined

acs.text: WHEN a test file on disk was not executed by any runner THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the collection check, naming the file and its level
scenarios: AC-002 fail the collection check, naming the file and its level

acs.text: WHEN a quarantine entry has expired, or lacks a reason, an issue link, or an expiry within 30 days THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the quarantine check
WHEN a quarantined test fails THE SYSTEM SHALL report a notice and not fail, and WHEN a test that is not quarantined fails THE SYSTEM SHALL fail
scenarios: AC-004 report a notice and not fail, and WHEN a test that is not quarantined fails

acs.text: WHEN nightly.yml and e2e-reader.yml are read THE SYSTEM SHALL schedule flake detection, collection, mutation, audit, contract drift, docs freshness, doctor and holdout jobs, keep L4b disabled with its reason until the reader seam lands, and configure Stryker for Vitest
scenarios: AC-005 schedule flake detection, collection, mutation, audit, contract drift, docs freshness, doc
